title: OLX Scraper Health
description: Direct views of current listings, recorded price changes, scrape runs, and observed closures in the lean schema. Historical charts use retained event timestamps rather than reconstructed daily inventory.

filters.name: category
filters.label: Category (search tables)
filters.options_sql: SELECT DISTINCT category AS __value FROM lean.saved_searches WHERE category IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Searches watched
panels.sql: SELECT count(*) AS searches FROM lean.saved_searches

panels.title: Failed runs · 24 h
panels.sql:
WITH a AS (
  SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='error' AND started_at>now()-INTERVAL '24 hours') AS failed_24h,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='ok' AND started_at>now()-INTERVAL '24 hours') AS ok_24h,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('ok','error') AND started_at>now()-INTERVAL '24 hours') AS finished_24h,
    max(finished_at) FILTER (WHERE status='ok' AND is_complete) AS last_success,
    coalesce(sum(cards) FILTER (WHERE status='ok' AND started_at>now()-INTERVAL '24 hours'),0) AS cards_24h,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT is_complete AND status IN ('ok','error') AND finished_at IS NOT NULL AND started_at>now()-INTERVAL '24 hours') AS incomplete
  FROM lean.scrape_runs
)
SELECT failed_24h,
  round(100.0*ok_24h/NULLIF(finished_24h,0),0) AS success_rate,
  round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now()-last_success)))::bigint AS seconds_since_success,
  cards_24h, incomplete
FROM a

panels.title: Runs per hour — ok vs error
panels.sql: SELECT date_trunc('hour',started_at) AS time,count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='ok') AS ok,count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='error') AS error,count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='running') AS running FROM lean.scrape_runs WHERE ${time_filter:started_at} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Cards & pages per run — hourly averages
panels.sql: SELECT date_trunc('hour',started_at) AS time,round(avg(cards))::int AS "avg cards",round(avg(pages))::int AS "avg pages" FROM lean.scrape_runs WHERE ${time_filter:started_at} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Saved searches — stalest first
panels.sql: SELECT name,coalesce(category,'(none)') AS category,listing_count AS listings,median_ppm2 AS "median KM/m2",new_count AS new,drop_count AS drops,round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now()-last_scraped_at))/60)::int AS age_min,url FROM lean.saved_searches WHERE ${category}='All' OR category=${category} ORDER BY last_scraped_at NULLS FIRST

panels.title: Recent scrape runs — newest 50
panels.sql: SELECT r.id,coalesce(s.category,'(none)') AS category,r.search_key,r.status,r.pages,r.cards,r.started_at AS started,r.finished_at AS finished,r.error FROM lean.scrape_runs r LEFT JOIN lean.saved_searches s USING(search_key) ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Geo pins · actives
panels.sql:
SELECT round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE latitude IS NOT NULL AND longitude IS NOT NULL)/NULLIF(count(*),0)) AS pinned_pct,
  round(100.0*count(details_fetched_at)/NULLIF(count(*),0)) AS details_pct,
  round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE ppm2>0)/NULLIF(count(*),0)) AS priced_pct,
  round(100.0*count(api_status)/NULLIF(count(*),0)) AS api_status_pct
FROM lean.listings WHERE closed_at IS NULL

panels.title: OLX status vs closure state · recently seen
panels.sql: SELECT coalesce(api_status,'(not exposed)') AS olx_says,CASE WHEN closed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'closed' ELSE 'open' END AS we_say,count(*) AS listings FROM lean.listings WHERE last_seen>now()-INTERVAL '14 days' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: Search duration — slowest first
panels.sql: SELECT s.name,coalesce(s.category,'(none)') AS category,count(r.id) AS runs,round(avg(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.finished_at-r.started_at))))::int AS avg_s,max(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.finished_at-r.started_at)))::int AS max_s FROM lean.scrape_runs r JOIN lean.saved_searches s USING(search_key) WHERE r.finished_at IS NOT NULL AND ${time_filter:r.started_at} GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 4 DESC

panels.title: Detail backlog · eligible actives
panels.sql: SELECT count(*) AS backlog FROM lean.listings WHERE closed_at IS NULL AND (details_fetched_at IS NULL OR details_fetched_at<now()-INTERVAL '7 days') AND (last_enrichment_attempted_at IS NULL OR last_enrichment_attempted_at<now()-INTERVAL '12 hours')

panels.title: Listings with invalid latest price state · 30 d
panels.sql: SELECT count(*) AS invalid_latest FROM lean.listings WHERE extra->>'latest_price_state' IN ('invalid','conflict') AND last_seen>now()-INTERVAL '30 days'

panels.title: Errors grouped — last 7 d
panels.sql: SELECT count(*)::int AS runs,left(regexp_replace(coalesce(error,'(no message)'), '[0-9]+','#','g'),120) AS failure_pattern,max(started_at) AS last_seen FROM lean.scrape_runs WHERE status='error' AND started_at>now()-INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY 2 ORDER BY 1 DESC

panels.title: Run duration over time
panels.sql: SELECT date_trunc('hour',started_at) AS time,round(avg(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (finished_at-started_at)))/60.0,1) AS "avg min",round(max(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (finished_at-started_at)))/60.0,1) AS "max min" FROM lean.scrape_runs WHERE finished_at IS NOT NULL AND ${time_filter:started_at} GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Per-search freshness & phases
panels.sql: SELECT s.name,s.category,s.search_key,CASE WHEN r.status='error' THEN 'failed' WHEN r.status='running' THEN 'running' WHEN r.finished_at<now()-INTERVAL '26 hours' THEN 'stale' ELSE coalesce(r.status,'never') END AS phase,round(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now()-r.finished_at))/60)::int AS age_min,r.started_at,r.finished_at,r.error,s.url FROM lean.saved_searches s LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM lean.scrape_runs WHERE search_key=s.search_key ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) r ON TRUE WHERE ${category}='All' OR s.category=${category} ORDER BY r.finished_at NULLS FIRST
